prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Discover Your Companion Archetype", "Explore different companion traits and choose the story path that fits your desktop vibe best."]
1: ["Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe", "Using the same email binds your existing pet data. Signing in with a new email creates a blank pet profile."]
2: ["Upload Clear Photos for Best Pet Quality", "Ensure bright lighting and a clear front view to prevent rendering glitches.", "Photo Lighting & Angle Verification"]
3: ["Select your pet and personalize their starter gear next."]
4: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Give your new companion a name to begin your journey together."]
5: ["Preparing Your Pet for Desktop Arrival", "Your companion is getting ready. You will hear a chime when they land on your screen.", "Estimated Assembly Time"]
6: ["Calibrating Desktop Bounds", "We are verifying screen compatibility so your pet spawns seamlessly."]
7: ["Master Your Desktop Companion Controls", "Learn how to command your pet directly from your screen or taskbar.", "Hide, Show & Chat Shortcuts"]
8: ["Pick Your Pet's Preferred Playstyle", "Select how your pet behaves on your desktop. Don't worry, you can switch paths anytime in settings.", "Choose freely—your path choice can be changed at any point later."]
9: ["Tip: Right-click the system tray icon anytime to quickly hide or summon your pet.", "Quick Desktop Controls"]
